summary.text: Julie McGuire is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 93 who has represented the district since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a former policy analyst with the Indiana Senate Republicans.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Eva Rosberg, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: McGuire was born in Indianapolis and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Indiana University.
Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit advocate and as a policy analyst with the Indiana Senate Republicans.
She has served on the Roncalli High School Board of Directors and as president of the Northwest Perry Township Neighborhood Association.
She took office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2022, succeeding John Jacob.
